name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new idea
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem would this solve?**
Describe what you are trying to do and what gets in the way. Sometimes the
problem has a simpler fix than the feature itself.

**What would you like to see?**
Describe the behavior or screen you have in mind, as concretely as you
can. For dashboard ideas, a rough sketch or a description of what the
screen would show helps a lot.

**Alternatives you have considered**
Any other ways you thought about solving this, including tools that
already do it.
